competition_search_terms: ITAD asset disposition tracking chain of custody wipe certificate software
Türkiye ITAD veri silme varlık imha yazılımı
results.market_gap: Lightweight segment exists, but direct software competition already implements the core workflow.
results.mvp: Asset intake, wipe evidence, disposition matrix, custody events, reuse/recycle report.
results.working_logic: Register asset -> attach wipe proof -> choose next-life path -> record custody -> export evidence.
results.marketing_strategy: Target small ITAD/refurbisher operators via compliance content.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot with one small refurbisher using spreadsheet-based custody records.
results.validation_assumption: MVP excludes certified erasure engine and records third-party evidence.
results.rejection_reason: Multiple direct products already provide substantially the same custody/wipe/disposition evidence workflow.

competition_search_terms: data center power permit compliance software commissioning
permit obligation evidence renewal facility software
results.market_gap: Data-center-power specialization could be a niche, but core workflow is already directly served by configurable permit-management products.

results.first_customer_plan: Manual pilot for one behind-the-meter generation project.
results.main_risk: Generic permit suites are configurable to same workflow.
results.local_applicability_rationale: Trakya transferability was hypothesized but no fresh Lüleburgaz-specific data-center/on-site generation footprint was established in this validation.
results.rejection_reason: Direct permit-management suites substantially cover the same obligation/evidence/renewal workflow.

results.market_gap: Established IGA tools perform role mining, but fresh search did not verify a lightweight product centered on migration-time source-role -> target-entitlement mapping, exception review and sign-off.
results.mvp: CSV imports, source-role/target-entitlement matrix, suggestions/rules, exceptions, reviewer sign-off, export.
results.working_logic: Import workforce/legacy roles -> propose mappings -> review exceptions -> approve packages -> export target assignments.
results.first_customer_plan: Pilot on anonymized role/entitlement CSVs from one migration project.
results.main_risk: IGA vendors may cover enough of the workflow through services/configuration.
results.validation_assumption: MVP does not provision access; it produces reviewed mappings for downstream import.
